run_convert_scenewise_to_imagewise: run the BOP scenewise to imagewise converter CLI with --input and --output arguments
run_convert_with_scene_ids: run the converter for specific scenes using --scene-ids 4,5,6 flag
run_convert_multiprocess: run the converter with multiple subprocesses using --nprocs flag for parallel processing
review_convert_scene_to_imagewise: review the convert_scene_to_imagewise function that transforms BOP scenewise scene data to imagewise format
review_parse_args: review the parse_args function that defines CLI arguments for input, output, scene-ids, and nprocs
